info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Review Submission API
info.description: The Product Review Submission API enables businesses to collect and manage customer feedback for their banking products. This endpoint allows users to submit reviews associated with specific product deployments, thereby enhancing product visibility and customer engagement. Typical consumers include product managers and customer service teams who leverage this feedback to improve offerings. The API streamlines the process of gathering insights and building stronger customer relationships through structured review data.
